findings.title: Public Continue/Retry pool-error observations are not checked before reset
findings.evidence: Observing _prepare_snapshot calls genuine super, observes quiet committed installation and appends _test_errors when actual committed candidate is still in a registered/legacy validation pool. Public Continue and GUI Retry use inherited _perform with empty _test_current. settle_operation reports only settled/campaign_error; smoke _settle tests only those existing success fields. The next TEST _perform resets _test_errors, so that measured positive-flow adapter error can be silently discarded.
findings.impact: The fixture cannot claim mechanically asserted exclusive installation for its positive public Continue/Retry flows even though it already measures membership. This is a fixture observation/assertion gap, not demonstrated production breakage.
findings.minimal_test_only_repair: Expose retained actual adapter errors through a read-only observing-shell getter, include those actual errors in every settled receipt, and require an empty Array in smoke _settle before subsequent TEST reset; alternatively pass/check actual committed membership at observation. Keep String/bool validator dispatch and original super mechanics unchanged.
